articles.title: Presidente da Venezuela agradece apoio do Brasil
articles.summary: President Lula spoke by phone with Venezuela's president Delcy Rodríguez to discuss Brazilian humanitarian aid sent after earthquakes that struck Venezuela in late June.

articles.title: PF conclui que Flávio Bolsonaro cometeu calúnia contra Lula nas redes
articles.summary: Brazil's Federal Police concluded that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro committed slander against President Lula in social media posts making accusations about drug trafficking and money laundering.

articles.title: O que Trump fez foi coisa desaforada, diz Lula sobre novo tarifaço
articles.summary: During the G7 summit in France, President Lula criticized U.S. President Donald Trump's suggestion of new tariffs against Brazil during ongoing bilateral negotiations.

articles.title: Lula diz que combate ao crime deve respeitar a soberania dos estados
articles.summary: At the G7 meeting, President Lula defended that drug trafficking enforcement must be comprehensive and respect state sovereignty while being linked to development agendas.

articles.title: Convidado do G7, Brasil leva voz do Sul Global à Cúpula, diz Lula
articles.summary: President Lula participated in the G7 summit in Évian, France as an invited guest, representing the Global South's commitment to peace, multilateralism, and sustainable development.
